Name: Minakie's Chicken Overhaul
Author: Minakie
TagLine: Vanilla chicken (blue, brown, void and white) reskin.
Description:
___<s>![](https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png) </s>___

I found some [free to use livestock bases](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-free-to-edit-wips-crucifigos-livestock-semi-realistic-animal-replacers.109480/)and decided to use them to recolor my chickens. The [baby chicks](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/elles-barn-and-coop-animal-replacements.126156/)that I thought were from the vanilla game are from Elle after all. No wonder I thought they were so cute.
I still want to add an additional chicken color. I may or may not work on more animals in the future.
But, given my chronic depression, probably not. At least not anytime soon.

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/918-0-1486919240.png)

<s>A backup of the vanilla chickens files is provided with this mod, so don't worry about losing them if you want them back later.

**_![](https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png) _**

Copy-paste the Content folder into your "...\Stardew Valley" main folder and, when prompted, let it override.</s>

_![](https://i.postimg.cc/SKDkt5hJ/update.png)
_
This mod is now updated to work with Content Patcher, so it will no longer replace any game files.
